fact: A brilliant blue supergiant — the luminous foot of Orion, tens of thousands of times brighter than the Sun.
bio: Rigel (Beta Orionis) is a hot blue supergiant several hundred light-years away, one of the most intrinsically luminous stars visible to the naked eye. Despite the 'Beta' designation it usually outshines Betelgeuse.
cultural: The name comes from the Arabic for 'foot'. Rigel's steely blue-white light is a classic contrast to Betelgeuse's red across the figure of Orion.
